items.name: DP state design
items.description: Define DP states that capture necessary information.

items.name: Tree DP
items.description: Dynamic programming over rooted or unrooted tree structure.

items.name: Rerooting DP
items.description: Move a tree DP root across edges by reusing parent-side and child-side contributions.

items.name: Knapsack DP
items.description: Dynamic programming over capacity, budget, count, or resource constraints.

items.name: Bitmask DP
items.description: Dynamic programming with states indexed by masks over a small set of items or vertices.

items.name: Digit DP
items.description: Dynamic programming over digits with prefix, tightness, residue, or digit-sum state.

items.name: Interval DP
items.description: Dynamic programming over intervals, subarrays, substrings, or circular interval ranges.

items.name: LIS DP
items.description: Longest-increasing-subsequence style chain DP, including reductions to ordered tails or posets.

items.name: Subset DP
items.description: Dynamic programming over subsets with transitions between masks or subset partitions.

items.name: Probability DP
items.description: Dynamic programming over probabilities, expected values, or probability distributions.

items.name: Alien DP
items.description: Lagrangian-relaxation DP that searches a penalty parameter to recover a constrained optimum.

items.name: Monge DP optimization
items.description: Optimize DP or labeling transitions using Monge, quadrangle inequality, or monotone-decision structure.

items.name: DP transition optimization
items.description: Optimize transition cost or transition enumeration.

items.name: Slope trick
items.description: Represent and update a convex piecewise-linear DP cost function by slope changes or breakpoints.
